svg.text: #596 Enterprise AI Storage: DeepSeek 3FS vs. Lustre/WEKA & 2.8s Two-Phase Async Checkpointing
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · Cut 2.4TB Checkpoint Stall from 240s to 2.8s (85.7x Faster) · Aggregate Node Local NVMe via 3FS at $0 Array CapEx
1. Solving the 2.4TB Checkpoint GPU Stall (256 GPUs)
✕ Legacy Blocking Checkpoint to 10 GB/s Shared NFS/S3
• Freezes all 256 GPUs while writing 2,400 GB over network = 240.0s stall / 30 min
• Wastes 13.3%–18.5% of total cluster GPU hours ($108,800/mo burned waiting on I/O!)
✓ Two-Phase Async Checkpointing (PyTorch DCP + Local NVMe/3FS)
• Phase 1 (GPU Stall = 2.8s): Each GPU copies its 9.375 GB FSDP shard over
PCIe 5.0 (52 GB/s) to local Pinned Host DDR5 RAM → Training resumes immediately!
• Phase 2 (0s GPU Stall): Background CPU threads flush from DDR5 to local NVMe
3FS pool (55 GB/s/node) and tier asynchronously to S3 / Azure Blob
• Result: GPU Stall cut from 240.0s to 2.8s (85.7x faster) · 99.84% Training Goodput!
2. Four AI Storage Architectures (32 Nodes · 256 GPUs)
1. Disaggregated Local NVMe Fabric (DeepSeek 3FS + S3 Cold Tier) [BEST ROI]
• Pools 8× 3.84TB Gen5 NVMe inside each GPU server over RDMA → 1,760 GB/s aggregate!
• $0 External Storage Array CapEx · Perfect for KV Cache Offload & Async Checkpoints
2. Managed Cloud Parallel File System (Azure Managed Lustre / AWS FSx Lustre)
• Turnkey POSIX + Blob/S3 HSM hydration; provision ephemeral scratch only during jobs
3. Enterprise Software-Defined Parallel FS (WEKA / VAST Data + GPUDirect Storage)
• Strongest small-file IOPS (millions of 4KB image/audio files) + multi-tenant snapshots
4. High-Speed Object Storage (S3 Express One Zone / Mountpoint + WebDataset Tar)
• Pack small files into 512MB WebDataset/MDS shards to eliminate metadata IOPS walls
3. Small-File Metadata Wall Rule (100M Multimodal Images/Audio)
• Never read 100M individual 50KB JPEG/WAV files directly over POSIX/NFS (Metadata MDS locks cap GPU util at 18%).
• Pack into 512MB MosaicML Streaming (MDS) / WebDataset shards to convert random 4KB IOPS into 50 GB/s sequential streaming.
